title: Noetherian ideal torsion equals derived closed support
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $I\subseteq A$ be a finitely generated ideal, and put $Z=V(I)$. Write $D(A)$ for the derived category of $A$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $R\Gamma_I$ be the total right derived functor of the ideal-power torsion functor $\Gamma_I$ [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor], computed by applying $\Gamma_I$ termwise to a K-injective resolution (a complex into which every map from an acyclic complex is null-homotopic). Let $R\Gamma_Z$ be the right adjoint of [lem-per-local-cohomology-adjoint-cech] to inclusion of the full subcategory with $I$-power-torsion cohomology into $D(A)$. Then the canonical comparison $R\Gamma_I(K)\to R\Gamma_Z(K)$ is an isomorphism for every $K\in D(A)$. This comparison is the unique factorization of the canonical map $R\Gamma_I(K)\to K$ through the adjunction counit $R\Gamma_Z(K)\to K$, using the $I$-power-torsion cohomology of $R\Gamma_I(K)$. In particular this isomorphism is natural in $K$.
